artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Work in the ring of symmetric functions in variables x = (x_1, x_2, ...) with coefficients in ℚ(q,t). For coprime integers a, b ≥ 1, let Θ_{a,b} denote the symmetric-function operator associated with the (a,b)-action coming from the elliptic Hall algebra / rectangular Catalan combinatorics, and define the operator-twisted symmetric functions
   f^{(a,b)}_λ(x;q,t) := Θ_{a,b}(f_λ)(1)
for any symmetric function f_λ. In particular, for the hook partition (j+1, 1^k) (one part equal to j+1 and k parts equal to 1), let s_{(j|k)}(x) be the corresponding Schur function and set
   s^{(a,b)}_{(j|k)}(x;q,t) := Θ_{a,b}(s_{(j|k)})(1).

For arbitrary positive integers m, n write (m,n) = (ad, bd) with d = gcd(m,n) and gcd(a,b) = 1, and define
   e_{m,n}(x;q,t) := e^{(a,b)}_d(x;q,t),    h_{m,n}(x;q,t) := h^{(a,b)}_d(x;q,t),
where e_d, h_d are the elementary and complete homogeneous symmetric functions of degree d.

Let α(m,n) be the number of integer lattice points strictly between the line segment from (0,0) to (m,n) and the diagonal-avoiding (m,n)-staircase path lying weakly above this segment, and set
   β := α(m,n) − d + 1,
which equals the number of lattice points that lie between the diagonal-avoiding (m,n)-staircase path and the (m−1,n)-staircase path.

For symmetric functions f, g over ℚ(q,t), write f ⪯_s g if and only if g − f is Schur-positive, i.e., expands in the Schur basis with coefficients in ℕ[q,t].

Question. Prove (or disprove) that the following two Schur-positivity inequalities hold simultaneously:
 (i) For all coprime a, b ≥ 1 and all integers j, k ≥ 0,
     q · (−1)^{j} s^{(a,b)}_{(j+1 \mid k−1)}(x;q,t)  ⪯_s  (−1)^{j−1} s^{(a,b)}_{(j \mid k)}(x;q,t).
 (ii) For all integers m, n ≥ 1, with d = gcd(m,n) and β as above,
     q^{β} · e_{m−1,n}(x;q,t)  ⪯_s  (−qt)^{1−d} · h_{m,n}(x;q,t).
artifact.category_tag: Symmetric functions and rectangular Catalan combinatorics
artifact.status_search_result: The two Schur-inclusion conjectures concerning hook-indexed and (e,h)-indexed images under the rectangular (a,b)-operators appear to remain open. They are part of a family of Schur-positivity conjectures by F. Bergeron in rectangular Catalan combinatorics; recent surveys (including Bergeron's 2021 monograph on symmetric functions and rectangular Catalan combinatorics) still list such Schur-inclusion problems among unresolved questions, and no proof in the stated generality was found.

status_evidence.title: Symmetric Functions and Rectangular Catalan Combinatorics (F. Bergeron, 2021)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Schur-positivity / Schur-inclusion conjectures for operators on symmetric functions arising in rectangular Catalan combinatorics, presented as open problems.
status_evidence.claim: Bergeron's 2021 monograph still presents these Schur-inclusion conjectures as open.

status_evidence.title: Open Questions for operators related to Rectangular Catalan Combinatorics
status_evidence.snippet: Lists open questions about Schur positivity, Schur inclusion, and e-inclusion for symmetric functions arising from operators in the elliptic Hall algebra.
status_evidence.claim: The hook-Schur and e/h Schur-inclusion inequalities are stated as open questions.
